specs.label: Enable sequence viewer (set seq_view, 1)
specs.note: The SequenceViewer's only data feed is source.rows() -> cmd.tenmol_seqview, a bridge-only helper (packages/bridge/tenmol_bridge/panels/seqview.py). engine-ts does not port that command, so in local mode the poll throws, payload.visible stays false and the .seqview strip never mounts (verified live: after `set seq_view, 1` no .seqview element appears). The whole area therefore requires the remote PyMOL bridge.

specs.label: Disable sequence viewer (set seq_view, 0)
specs.note: seq_view 0 unmounts the strip (rendered = visible && rows>0) and the reservation effect must clear the scene inset it reserved (reserve.ts).

specs.label: Format ▸ Residue Codes (seq_view_format 0)
specs.note: Header span titled seq_view_format shows FORMAT_NAMES[0] = 'Residue Codes'.

specs.label: Format ▸ Residue Names (seq_view_format 1)
specs.note: Header shows FORMAT_NAMES[1] = 'Residue Names'; each cell widens to the 3-letter code.

specs.label: Format ▸ Atom Names (seq_view_format 2)
specs.note: Header shows FORMAT_NAMES[2] = 'Atom Names'; row expands to thousands of atom columns (virtualised window).

specs.label: Format ▸ Chain Identifiers (seq_view_format 3)
specs.note: Header shows FORMAT_NAMES[3] = 'Chain Identifiers'.

specs.label: Format ▸ States (seq_view_format 4)
specs.note: Header shows FORMAT_NAMES[4] = 'States'. This is the codes==4 mode that flips row.selectable off for non-discrete states.

specs.label: Format ▸ Movie Frames (seq_view_format 5)
specs.note: Header shows FORMAT_NAMES[5] = 'Movie Frames'.

specs.label: Location ▸ Bottom (seq_view_location 1)
specs.note: location 1 adds the seqview--bottom modifier class and reserves scene space at the bottom (reserve.ts reservationFor).

specs.label: Location ▸ Top (seq_view_location 0)
specs.note: location 0 adds the seqview--top modifier class and reserves scene space at the top.

specs.label: Overlay ON (seq_view_overlay 1)
specs.note: overlay 1 adds the seqview--overlay class (draws over the scene) and clears the scene-space reservation (reserve.ts).

specs.label: Overlay OFF (seq_view_overlay 0)
specs.note: overlay 0 removes the seqview--overlay class and re-reserves scene space; viewport canvas shrinks.

specs.label: Label mode ▸ object name inline (seq_view_label_mode 0)
specs.note: label_mode 0 hides the number/breadcrumb label row and prints /object inline via .seqrow__name.

specs.label: Label mode ▸ first row only (seq_view_label_mode 1)
specs.note: label_mode 1 draws the label row on the first row only (showLabelRow index===0).

specs.label: Label mode ▸ every row (seq_view_label_mode 2)
specs.note: label_mode 2 (default) draws a .seqrow__labels row above every sequence row.

specs.label: Gap mode (seq_view_gap_mode) toggle
specs.note: seq_view_gap_mode controls whether gap/spacer columns (is-spacer cells) are drawn between residues; changing it re-renders the row.

specs.label: Aligned view ▸ unaligned mode (seq_view_unaligned_mode)
specs.note: Only meaningful under an active alignment (ExecutiveGetActiveAlignment); the header shows UNALIGNED_NAMES[n] e.g. 'staggered'. Needs two objects + an alignment object, so it is bridge-only and also requires aligned data.

specs.label: Aligned view ▸ fill character (seq_view_fill_char)
specs.note: Under an alignment, gap holes are painted with .seqfill spans repeating seq_view_fill_char; changing the char re-renders the fill.

specs.label: Cell left-click selects the residue
specs.note: onPointerDown -> click() grammar: a left press on a selectable cell emits toggle(include=true) -> source.select; the cell gains is-selected (inverse video) and a minimap tick. Driver's plain click reproduces the left button.

specs.label: Cell left-click again deselects (toggle off)
specs.note: A fresh press toggles the cell the other way (include = !selected); clicking an already-selected cell removes it from the active selection.

specs.label: Cell Ctrl+left-click centers the active selection
specs.note: ctrl+left additionally emits centerSelection -> cmd.center on the active selection (grammar :419-421). LIMITATION: the audit driver's click action carries no modifier keys, so the ctrl branch cannot be driven deterministically; the closest observable is a plain click causing a render change.

specs.label: Cell middle-click browses/centers the residue
specs.note: Middle button emits browse -> source.center (SeekerSelectionCenter). LIMITATION: driver has no middle-button action; recorded with the closest observable (a click over the cell) and a render check.

specs.label: Cell Ctrl+middle-click zooms the residue
specs.note: ctrl+middle sets browse.zoom=true -> source.center(zoom=1) (SeekerSelectionCenter zoom). LIMITATION: no middle-button/modifier action in the driver; closest observable is a render change.

specs.label: Cell right-click opens the residue (seq_option) menu
specs.note: Right button -> click() emits menu('seq_option') -> source.menu builds a pymol.menu tree rendered by RowMenu (.menu__row). LIMITATION: the driver's click is left-button only; the contextmenu/right-button path cannot be driven, so this is recorded as the closest affordance.

specs.label: Right-click a selected cell opens the selection (pick_sele) menu
specs.note: When a cell is IN the active selection and hasActiveSele, right-click emits menu('pick_sele') for the selection itself rather than the residue. LIMITATION: no right-button action in the driver.

specs.label: Left-drag across cells selects a residue range
specs.note: onPointerDown then onPointerEnter with buttons!=0 runs the SeekerDrag reducer (move()) emitting range toggles; dragging back past the anchor UNDOES the outbound leg. LIMITATION: the driver has no press-hold-move drag primitive; recorded as a single click as the closest observable.

specs.label: Shift+left-click extends the last drag (range continuation)
specs.note: shift+left on the row the last drag was on keeps the anchor and re-runs move() to extend/flip the span (grammar :349-365). LIMITATION: the driver click carries no shift modifier.

specs.label: Click a state-carrying cell sets the object state
specs.note: In Movie-Frames/States format a cell carries col->state; clicking it additionally emits setState -> source.setState (SettingSetSmart cSetting_state). Needs a multi-state object; bridge-only.

specs.label: Double left-click empty area clears the selection
specs.note: onBackgroundDown: a left click outside a cell/scrollbar within cDoubleTime emits clear -> source.clear (SeekerClick :328-341). LIMITATION: needs two rapid clicks on the header/empty tail; timing/target is approximate under the driver.

specs.label: Right-click empty area opens the active-selection menu
specs.note: onBackgroundDown: right button with an active selection emits menu('pick_sele', row=-1) (SeekerClick :240-248). LIMITATION: no right-button action in the driver.

specs.label: Native context menu is suppressed over the strip
specs.note: onContextMenu={preventDefault} on the .seqview container stops the browser menu so PyMOL's own popup can take over. Not directly observable through the driver's action set; recorded for completeness.

specs.label: Mouse wheel scrolls one column
specs.note: onWheel -> wheel(deltaY) -> scrollBy(+/-1); the header range text (first+1..count/maxCols) and the .seqview__thumb position change. LIMITATION: the driver has no wheel action, so this cannot be driven; recorded with the closest observable.

specs.label: Click the scrollbar/mini-map jumps to that column
specs.note: .seqview__scroll onPointerDown computes fraction = (clientX-left)/width and scrollTo(fraction*maxCols); the thumb moves and the visible window shifts. A plain click at the element's center reproduces a jump to roughly the middle column.

specs.label: Right-click menu leaf runs its PyMOL command
specs.note: RowMenu onPick(command) closes the popup and runs session.run(command) then refresh() — the leaves are literal PyMOL command strings from pymol.menu. Reaching it needs the right-click popup first (see seqview.cell.rightClick.menu), which the driver cannot open.

specs.label: Right-click menu lazy submenu expands (SubGetItem)
specs.note: RowMenu onExpand(path) calls source.menuExpand -> grafts resolved children into the open menu (graftMenu). Reaching it needs the right-click popup first, which the driver cannot open.

specs.label: Right-click menu closes on dismiss
specs.note: RowMenu onClose sets menu=null (Escape / click-away). Reaching it needs the right-click popup first, which the driver cannot open.
